messages:
Zoe (CEO): Quick ask after today's all-hands — need a 1-line partner-friendly update for API / Console / Optimize + the single biggest risk for each. Keep it short.

Mara (Product): API: limited preview next week; benefits: simpler auth and more stable SDKs. Top risk: auth v2 rollout could disrupt long-lived connections.

Kevin L (Eng): Confirmed. Were doing a 10% canary and monitoring connection resets. Rollback plan ready.

Jess (Eng PM): Console: opt-in canary for route analytics and a cleaned-up onboarding flow in June. Top risk: telemetry schema change needs coordination with docs and SDKs.

Alex (Optimize): Optimize: preview for automated batching/cache recommendations to cut per-token cost. Top risk: some customers may want to opt out of auto-quant/auto-batching UX.

Sam (Docs): I'll prepare partner-friendly phrasing + a short FAQ about opt-in/opt-out. PR by tomorrow morning.

Riley (SRE): Infra note: auth toggle might cause brief routing syncs; were validating a zero-blip approach but not fully proven.

Ops (Release): Can we get final sign-off by Friday 17:00 UTC? Need to lock canary windows and inform customers.

Mara (Product): Draft partner lines (short):
- API: "Limited preview: improved security and SDK alignment to smooth integrations."
- Console: "Opt-in preview: clearer route insights to help teams measure performance."
- Optimize: "Preview: suggested batching and cache tips to reduce inference cost."

Zoe (CEO): Good. Keep wording benefits-first. I'll send to partners after Sam posts the final copy.

DevRel Bot: Ticket created: OPS-8422 "opt-out control for optimize preview" assigned to Alex.

Kevin L (Eng): We'll run an extra canary validation tonight; report by 06:00 UTC.

Mara (Product): Thanks — I'll bundle these into the comms note and tag Zoe for final sign-off. If any canary flags appear, ping this thread ASAP. :thumbsup:
